title: (Deprecated) Get all videos
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get all videos that are generated from a material package. > **Note**
The Dynamic Scene API is now in beta. If you would like access to this feature, please apply for the allowlisting using the [Allowlist Management](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/blog/detail/7102266224578396162) page. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/dynamic_scene/get/| /v1.3/dynamic_scene/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string | |Response parameter name|`url` |`video_preview_url` | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/dynamic_scene/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID. | |material_package_id {Required}|string|Material Package ID.| | page | number | Page that you want to get. | | page_size | number | Number of results on each page. Default value: 10. | ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|Returned data.| #|list|object[]|Videos generated in a specified material package ID.| ##|video_id|string|Video ID. | ##|video_preview_url|string|Preview link of the video. Notice that the period of validity is 24 hours. | ##|music_id|string|Music materials. You can get music IDs through [Music Upload](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740052650395650) endpoint. | ##|music_name|string|Music name. | ##|music_preview_url|string|Music link. | ##|width|number| Video width.| ##|height|number| Video height.| ##|duration|number|Video Duration (Seconds). | ##|story_arc|string[]|Refers to the structure and shape of a story, consisting of multiple slots.| ##|slots |object[]|Slot information.| ###|order |number|The order of the story arc, ranging from 0 to 5.| ###|tag |string|The tag of a slot.| ###|video_ids|string[]|Video materials. You can get video IDs through [Video Upload](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737587322856449) endpoint. | ###|mute|boolean|Whether to turn on the soundtrack of a scene. | ###|bgm_volume|number|The volume of background music, as an integer, ranging from [0, 100].| #|page_info|object| Pagination information. | ##|page |number| Current page number. | ##|page_size |number| Page size. | ##|total_number |number|Total number of results. | ##|total_page |number| Total pages of results. | |request_id |string|The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. |
